title: Mera Hussain
body:
Mera Hussain... ...mera Hussain...
..mera Hussainussain....
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par...
Tadap ke kahti hai maa be kafan hai teero par..
(((1)))
Koi to puche ki es maa pe kya guzarti hai
Ke kaise Tegh kaleje pe maa ke chalti hai
Kaha ye maa ne mera gulbadan hai teero par...
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((2)))
Main samne hu tere sar barhaina ay beta
Kuch intezaar karo aayege tere baba.
Unhe khabar hai tumhara badan hai teero par..
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((3)))
Khuda ka deen bachana hai deke sar apna
Ibadato ko sajana hai deke sar apna.
Waqar e Deene Rasool e Zaman hai teero par..
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((4)))
Kahi pe lashaye Abbas to kahi akbar
Kahi pe joun Habib aur qasim o Asghar
Khuda ke deen Teri anjuman hai teero par...
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((5)))
Tumare halk se beta jo khoo nikalte hai
Ye dekh dekh ke jibril hath malte hai.
Jise jhulate the jhula wo tan hai teero par....
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par...
(((6)))
Khula sar hai kayamat hai binte Zahra ka..
Dayaar e shaam me gairat ye de rahi thi sada
Waha pe bhai yaha par bahen hai teero par..
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((7)))
Sabhi hai khoon ke pyaase jo ak pyaase ke
Hazaar dusman e Jaa hai Rasool zade ke.
Koi to soche ki tasnadahen hai teero par.....
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par..
(((8)))
Na kaise roye koi sun ke wakeya shohrat
Lahu me garq hai maidaan e karbala shohrat.
Sar e Hussain hai naize pe tan hai teero par .
Mera Hussain ghareebul watan hai teero par
